Sea You Surfers Nest
Sea You Surfers Nest

Midigama, Sri Lanka

At a glance

A bed and breakfast in Midigama, on Sri Lanka’s south coast.

“Hello to waves in a minute walk,” says the house’s own listing.

Free WiFi in public areas | Kitchen | Fan and mosquito net | Free private parking on site

Seven rooms

All seven rooms are doubles, and between them they sleep fourteen. Only one has air conditioning, so ask when you book if you want the one that has it.

The rooms are furnished much alike. The bed is a mint-green four-poster double with a teal velvet throw on it, and there’s a timber towel ladder and a green cabinet with a mirror.

In every room
Mint-green four-poster double
Teal velvet throw
Timber towel ladder
Green cabinet with a mirror
Fan and mosquito net
Deluxe Double Room

1 large double bed | Sleeps 2

13 m², with its own bathroom, a private entrance, a terrace and a balcony.

See live dates
Standard Double Room

1 large double bed | Sleeps 2

12 m², with a private entrance and a wardrobe.

See live dates
Around the courtyard

Sea You is a white two-storey house. Downstairs there’s an inner courtyard, with potted plants and a cushioned bench, and the room doors that open onto it have carved fanlights over them.

From the balconies upstairs you look out over the garden to the coconut palms. There are tables and chairs out there, and the long one has a settee with green cushions.

Carved doors and a surfboard shower

One of the rooms has a carved grey double door, and the wooden chair beside it is carved too. Elsewhere, carved wooden masks hang by a doorway among the ferns.

Out in the garden there’s a shower built into a wooden surfboard, fixed to the wall under the palms. It’s for rinsing off after the sea.

Breakfast

Breakfast here is Asian, with local specialities and warm dishes, and there’s juice and fruit too.

Ashly

Your host is Ashly. He’s a Superhost on Airbnb and usually replies there within a few hours.

“Whether you’re chasing the perfect wave, soaking up the beach vibes, or just looking to unwind,” he writes, “our place is your perfect home away from home.”

We really enjoyed our stay! Great location and price! Private balcony outside of rooms. The host is extremely responsive and helpful. Let us check in sooner, was able to book an additional night, recommend where to get laundry done & sorted an airport transfer for us! Highly recommend staying here

Niamh | Airbnb | Jan 2026
Finding the house

Booking.com lists the house under Kumbalgama and Airbnb under Matara, but it’s one house, in Midigama.

Midigama railway station is 950 m away on foot and Weligama Beach is 3.4 km, both by Booking.com’s count.

151 Weliwaththa Rd, Midigama 80650, Sri Lanka

Open in Google Maps

Check-out 06:00–10:00 | Children of any age are welcome; there are no cots or extra beds. Pets on request, and charges may apply. No parties or events.

'false' : 'true'); }); dots.forEach((d, j) => d.setAttribute('aria-current', j === cur ? 'true' : 'false')); pill.style.transform = `translateX(${dots[cur].offsetLeft}px)`; onGo && onGo(cur); }; dots.forEach((d, i) => d.addEventListener('click', () => go(i))); ctrl.querySelector('.prev').addEventListener('click', () => go(cur - 1)); ctrl.querySelector('.next').addEventListener('click', () => go(cur + 1)); root.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.target.closest('.dot, .arw') || e.target.matches('.track')) { if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') { e.preventDefault(); go(cur + 1); } if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') { e.preventDefault(); go(cur - 1); } } }); // a horizontal swipe on a phone steps once; vertical scrolling is left alone (touch-action: pan-y) let x0 = null, y0 = 0; root.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => { if (e.pointerType !== 'mouse' && !e.target.closest('.ctrl')) { x0 = e.clientX; y0 = e.clientY; } }); root.addEventListener('pointerup', (e) => { if (x0 === null) return; const dx = e.clientX - x0, dy = e.clientY - y0; x0 = null; if (Math.abs(dx) > 40 && Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) go(cur + (dx < 0 ? 1 : -1)); }); root.addEventListener('pointercancel', () => { x0 = null; }); go(0); }; for (const show of document.querySelectorAll('[data-show]')) { const slides = [...show.querySelectorAll('.slide')]; // the next photo is fetched as soon as one is shown, so a tap never waits on a blank frame wire(show, slides, (i) => { const n = slides[(i + 1) % slides.length].querySelector('img'); if (n.loading === 'lazy') n.loading = 'eager'; }); } for (const box of document.querySelectorAll('[data-quotes]')) wire(box, [...box.querySelectorAll('.q')]); // the header turns solid and the phone bar slides up once the hero's own button has left the screen const top = document.querySelector('.top'), bar = document.getElementById('bar'); const heroBtn = document.querySelector('.btn-hero'), hero = document.querySelector('.hero'); new IntersectionObserver(([e]) => top.classList.toggle('solid', !e.isIntersecting), { rootMargin: '-72px 0px 0px 0px' }).observe(hero); new IntersectionObserver(([e]) => { const past = !e.isIntersecting && e.boundingClientRect.top < 0; bar.classList.toggle('on', past); if (!past) close(); }).observe(heroBtn); // the bar's chevron opens the at-a-glance summary above it (a disclosure, not a modal); Esc closes it const more = bar.querySelector('.bar-more'), panel = document.getElementById('bar-panel'); const close = (refocus) => { if (panel.hidden || panel.classList.contains('out')) return; const done = () => { panel.classList.remove('out'); panel.hidden = true; }; if (reduce) done(); else { panel.classList.add('out'); setTimeout(done, 180); } more.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'); more.setAttribute('aria-label', 'At a glance'); if (refocus) more.focus(); }; more.addEventListener('click', () => { if (!panel.hidden && !panel.classList.contains('out')) return close(); panel.classList.remove('out'); panel.hidden = false; more.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true'); more.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Close the summary'); }); document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') close(true); }); // desktop only: the Kube parallax, the hero photo drifts up by 4 rem as the hero leaves (off on phones) const img = document.querySelector('.hero-media img'); const wide = matchMedia('(min-width: 700px)'); if (!reduce) { let ticking = false; const step = () => { ticking = false; if (!wide.matches) { img.style.transform = ''; return; } const h = hero.offsetHeight, y = Math.min(Math.max(scrollY, 0), h); img.style.transform = `translate3d(0, ${(-64 * y / h).toFixed(2)}px, 0)`; }; addEventListener('scroll', () => { if (!ticking) { ticking = true; requestAnimationFrame(step); } }, { passive: true }); wide.addEventListener('change', step); A mint-green four-poster double with white sheets and striped pillows; a grey panelled double door stands open onto a veranda with a green table and chairs

Lime-green pillows and sheets on a mint-green bed, a teal throw across the foot and a potted plant beside it
A mint-green four-poster with white sheets next to a grey panelled door, a dark mirror shelf and a green bedside cabinet
A white bathroom with a pedestal sink under a black-framed mirror
A mint-green four-poster with grey sheets, a timber towel ladder, a mirror and a green cabinet beside a dark green door
A mint-green four-poster with grey pillows and a teal velvet throw under a ceiling fan
A mint-green four-poster with a teal throw beside a timber towel ladder, a green cabinet and a mirror
A wooden side table with a white tea set and a mint-green chair beside the foot of a four-poster
A concrete bench with a teal cushion in the courtyard, potted plants either side and palm trees above the wall
A mint-green table with a potted plant and two mint-green chairs on the upstairs balcony, palm fronds beyond the parapet
Two carved wooden armchairs with cane seats and a round wooden table on a balcony
A carved grey double door under a carved fanlight, a wall lamp beside it and a carved wooden chair
Carved wooden masks hanging beside a grey door with a carved panel, ferns and plants below
A shower built into a wooden surfboard fixed to a grey garden wall, the shower head above it and palms behind
